findings.element: Schedule card · day tabs when a validation error is on a day that is not open
findings.finding: When Save fails because of an error on another day, the only signal is that day's tab turning red; the summary doesn't name the day.
findings.user_impact: The operator has to scan eight tabs for a colour change before they can fix it and save.
findings.suggested_fix: Put the day names in the summary and an error count on each affected tab label.

evidence.action: Per day mode on the Sun tab, left '6' on the Mon tab, clicked Save
evidence.observed: Summary 'Fix 2 fields before saving'; Mon tab colour rgb(211,47,47); Sun tab shows no error text; tab label still 'Mon · 2'

findings.finding: The conflict blocks Save but doesn't name the station or device involved.
findings.user_impact: With several stations, the operator can't tell which station or event causes the clash.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the station and device in each conflict line.

evidence.action: Stations Akko + Ashkelon, Per day; clicked Save
evidence.observed: 'Fix 1 field before saving'; 'Conflicts with South line evening at Sun 23:00 on 1 device'; cleared only after removing the Ashkelon chip

findings.element: Schedule card · Every day / Per day toggle
findings.finding: Every day → Per day copies the events into every day, but Per day → Every day shows an empty list with no confirmation.
findings.user_impact: Collapsing a per-day schedule makes all events apparently disappear; Save fails with 'Add at least one event'.
findings.suggested_fix: Prefill the Every day list from the selected day, mirroring the other direction.

evidence.action: Opened 'Weekend shutdown — Ashkelon', clicked Every day, then Save
evidence.observed: List 'No events.', timeline off segments=0, no confirmation; Save → 'Add at least one event'

findings.finding: Holidays is an editable tab with its own events, but the timeline has no Holidays row.
findings.user_impact: No visual check of the Holidays pattern.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Holidays row whenever Per day mode is on.

evidence.action: Read the week card; opened the Holidays tab in Per day mode
evidence.observed: Timeline rows sun–sat only; Holidays tab has 2 events shown nowhere on the timeline
